subject: Could you provide an AWS ami?

messages.author: 506c24de863c4c82
messages.subject: Could you provide an AWS ami?
parts:
Hey,

I saw there was a windows version which is no long available. I'm working on a small package for submitting R script to EC2. There are a few advantages like better network, powerful machine on demand and so on. There are a few images with R installed, and SAS has an university version image there. If I start with a regular image, I may need to install R and other packages by myself. Moreover, package like XML require libxml2 so you can't install it directly. It would be very helpful if there is a image with RRO and regular package installed.

Thanks,

Jianyang

messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Re: Could you provide an AWS ami?
parts:
Hi Jianyang,

We don't have plans to create an official RRO AMI for AWS, but there are no restrictions on you (or anyone else) creating one or publishing one for others to use. (If you know of any, please share!)

Cheers,
# David
